subject: SecProd: Audit evidence & short-window BYOK triage
messages:
From: Sara Thompson <sara@clearhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit evidence for procurement review (audit logs, BYOK rotation, short retention)

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and security are running a quick supplier risk assessment and have three ask areas for us to validate before contract execution:

1) Audit logs: sample export showing per-tenant request events for inference requests (timestamp, model id, route, request id) for a 7-day window;
2) BYOK/KMS rotation: a statement of key rotation and access control proof for customer-managed keys (how we show that keys are rotated and that customer CMKs are used for encryption-in-flight vs. at-rest);
3) Short-window retention (we use a 30-day short-window policy internally): confirmation on whether ephemeral/short-window logs are recoverable and any evidence for audit that a 30-day retention was honored for a sample tenant.

Procurement would like an initial response with an evidence roadmap and any timelines we can commit to. If a quick package is possible (even preliminary), that will unblock the signature team.

Can you confirm scope and ETA?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Thompson
Security Program Manager, ClearHealth

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara@clearhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: audit evidence for procurement review (audit logs, BYOK rotation, short retention)

Folks — looping you in to triage ClearHealth's asks. I copied Sara so we remain transparent about timelines. Quick proposal below to keep this scoped and actionable.

Triage buckets (suggested):
- Priority A (deliver within 72 hours): sanitized audit-log export template for a 7-day window (anonymized tenant id), and a KMS rotation metadata extract showing last rotation timestamp + rotation policy reference. Owner: Marissa.
- Priority B (3–10 business days): SSO assertion logs mapped to session IDs (we may need engineering help to map request_id -> session_id). Owner: Ben + Priyom.
- Priority C (10–21 business days): evidence demonstrating a 30-day short-window retention for an existing tenant (this likely requires an operations playbook and time to assemble snapshots). Owner: Grace.

Attachments I think are useful: an audit_export_template.csv and a short KMS rotation statement. Marissa — can you confirm what's reachable from Hosted within 72hrs (no Prod infra changes)? Ben / Priyom — please flag blockers for session mapping. Grace — please estimate how long an evidence-pack for a retention proof would take.

Sara — we'll aim to send Priority A artifacts first and then a timeline for B/C. If procurement requires formal sign-off artifacts (DocuSign/attestation), say so and we'll route it.

Nikhil
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: audit evidence for procurement review (audit logs, BYOK rotation, short retention)

Thanks — quick technical check-in.

Priority A items:
- audit_export_template.csv (attached) is a sample export we can generate from the Hosted Audit API. It includes: utc_timestamp, tenant_hash, request_id, model_name, route, token_cost. We'll sanitize tenant identifiers and return a CSV extract. ETA: 48–72 hours.
- kms_rotation_materials.pdf (attached stub) — we can produce a signed PDF describing our rotation cadence, KMS access policies, and an encrypted metadata extract (rotation timestamps, key IDs). For ClearHealth's BYOK flows we have two variants: Dedicated with customer CMK managed in tenant KMS, and Hosted with Redwood-managed wrapping keys + customer-provided root. For procurement, I'll include a brief diagram. ETA: 48 hours.

Notes / blockers for Priority B: mapping session IDs to request_id will require a small join between the session-store and token-trace logs. Priyom — can you run a query to validate for a 7-day sample? If not, we may need a one-off tracing job. Ben — can you weigh in on privacy gating (we must ensure no PII leaves).

Priority C: Grace — retention proof will likely need an ops snapshot. If they want a technical attestation showing deletion timestamps, I estimate 8–12 business days to collect and scrub evidence for one tenant. If ClearHealth wants multiple tenants, scale accordingly.

I'm attaching initial artifacts for review: audit_export_template.csv, kms_rotation_materials.pdf. I'll begin the CSV extraction as soon as I get a go-ahead to sanitize production identifiers.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: audit_export_template.csv (CSV stub) | kms_rotation_materials.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara@clearhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: audit evidence for procurement review (audit logs, BYOK rotation, short retention)

Hi Sara — quick update and proposed timeline.

What you'll get this week (Priority A):
- A sanitized 7-day audit export in CSV (audit_export_template.csv) showing per-request events (UTC timestamps, anonymized tenant hash, request_id, model_name, route). ETA: Tue 20 Apr EOD.
- A short KMS rotation statement (kms_rotation_materials.pdf) including rotation timestamps and our policy for tenant-managed keys vs Redwood wrapping keys. ETA: Tue 20 Apr.

Follow-ups (Priority B/C):
- Session mapping and SSO assertion logs: Ben & Priyom will provide a path and an ETA by Fri 23 Apr after a quick join on session-store tables. (We will not export raw PII.)
- Short-window retention proof: Grace will scope an ops snapshot and propose an attestation playbook by Mon 26 Apr. Full evidence delivery estimated 8–12 business days after scope approval.

Deliverables will be posted to the shared Drive link below; we can also provide a redacted ZIP bundle if procurement needs a single artifact. If a formal attestation or DocuSign statement is required, let us know and we'll prepare the appropriate sign-off.

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-evidence
HubSpot ticket: HS-0048237

Sara — does that work for your timeline? If you need a tighter turnaround for any single artifact, call out Priority A1 and we'll reallocate.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_pack_v1.zip (initial stub to be replaced by sanitized artifacts)
